title: Scientific Self-Improvement without Self-Deception
hypothesis: Across 20 preregistered learning-process modifications, at least 4 changes deliver replicated improvements of >= 10% on primary metrics and survive untouched held-out evaluation sets without regressions > 3pp on designated controls.
falsification_criteria: Fewer than 4 modifications meet all criteria within the fixed research budget.
